a.lede: AI labs are toying with an industry-wide pact to slow development. Meanwhile, widely available AI chatbots are already helping uncover a tidal wave of security flaws.
a.title: Forget the AI Slowdown—the Vulnerability Explosion Is Already Happening

b.lede: As companies hand off longer and more complex tasks to AI agents, they are running into an oversight problem: Agents can act faster, longer, and at greater volume than humans can realistically review.
b.title: The fix for rogue AI agents could be more AI
